name: nvd
description: NVD (NIST) CVE API 2.0 — keyword search across the official vulnerability database. Free, no key required (5 req/30s); set NVD_API_KEY for a higher limit (50 req/30s).

name: cve_report
description: CVE.report aggregator — combines the canonical CVE Program record with NVD enrichment, CISA KEV and FIRST EPSS for a single CVE ID. Free, no key required. Not part of the generic per-run sweep (needs an exact CVE ID) — query it directly via POST /sources/cve_report/query with params={"query": "CVE-YYYY-NNNNN"}.

name: crtsh
description: crt.sh certificate transparency log search — subdomains and certs issued for a domain. Free, no key required. Be conservative with rate: crt.sh is a shared community service.

name: abuseipdb
description: AbuseIPDB IP reputation check (free tier: 1000 checks/day). Requires ABUSEIPDB_API_KEY — without it every call fails and gracefully degrades to a simulated result.

name: urlscan
description: urlscan.io search API — looks up existing public scans for a domain (read-only; never submits a new scan). Anonymous access has minor quotas; set URLSCAN_API_KEY for higher limits.

name: ip_api
description: ip-api.com free IP geolocation (no key, 45 req/min limit, HTTP only on the free tier — see their pro plan for HTTPS).

name: hackertarget
description: HackerTarget hostsearch — passive forward-DNS lookup listing the hostnames a domain resolves to. Free, no key, ~20 queries/day (50 results each); TTL 24h because the dataset changes slowly.

name: internetdb
description: Shodan InternetDB — free IP lookup (no key) of ports, CPEs and known CVEs reported for an IP, refreshed weekly. Static/'historical' by design: listings do not confirm anything live about the target.

name: shodan
description: Shodan host lookup for a single IP — ports, banners, org/ASN and any CVEs Shodan mapped to exposed services. Requires SHODAN_API_KEY (query param); without it the call fails and gracefully degrades to a simulated result. The vulnerability list is passively derived and may be stale — it never confirms exploitation.

name: censys
description: Censys hosts lookup for a single IP (Platform API v2). The free tier covers host/web-property/certificate lookup by IP; *search* requires a paid plan. Uses HTTP Basic auth with CENSYS_API_ID + CENSYS_API_SECRET; without them every call degrades to a simulated result.

name: rdap
description: Passive WHOIS via RDAP (RFC 9083) bootstrapped by rdap.org — registrar, nameservers and registration/expiration events for a domain. Free, no key; rdap.org redirects to the TLD registry, so the source follows redirects and the result is cached under the queried domain.

name: kev
description: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog — full feed of CVEs with evidence of active exploitation in the wild. Free, no key required. Not part of the per-run sweep (it is a full-catalog download); the CVE-correlation service queries it once and matches its own CVE IDs against this catalog.
